description: Operator view of the context-crisis work (epic ka-0000003733 Part B). Top-to-bottom arc: (1) HEADLINE — how big is the turn-0 boot right now, and is it the ~35k we drove it to or creeping back toward the ~90k crisis; (2) COMPOSITION — boot trend vs the crisis reference line, and the prime-hook byte breakdown; (3) ADVICE BUDGET & hottest live sessions; (4) TURN & COMPACTION pressure; (5) fleet OCCUPANCY distribution + token economics (cache-read share, the load proxy); (6) the two-measurement COST CROSS-CHECK that proves our meters are honest. Every expr is grounded against live gardenio-vmsingle (24h). Ship via helm (dashboards/context-observability.json), not UI edits.

panels.title: Boot Context Right Now — is the crisis under control?
Boot Context per Session (avg)
panels.description: gardenio_session_boot_context_tokens averaged over live sessions: the tokenized turn-0 resident context (base system prompt + MCP tool defs + skills + CLAUDE.md + gb prime + thread ctx) every session pays before doing any work. THE headline number of the context-crisis epic (ka-0000003733). Healthy post-fix regime is ~35-40k; 75k+ means we are sliding back toward the 70-90k boot the ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH flip (!5340) fixed. last_over_time so a quiet scrape never shows a false 0. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `count(gardenio_session_duration_seconds) > 0` — the one session metric `gb` pushes unconditionally on every session close — so a 0 here means sessions really are reporting, not that the push path went quiet.

defaults.noValue: exporter dark — no session has pushed metrics for this project/account, so a real 0 cannot be told apart from a silent push path

panels.title: Boot Share of Live Window
panels.description: avg boot tokens / avg live context tokens: what fraction of every context window is the fixed, immutable boot. If the boot is more than half the window, agents have little room to work before compaction. Reconstructs the 'how much does the boot cost you' composition story as a ratio. ~44% today. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `count(gardenio_session_duration_seconds) > 0` — the one session metric `gb` pushes unconditionally on every session close — so a 0 here means sessions really are reporting, not that the push path went quiet.

Neutral (informational), not a health signal. panels.title: Compactions in Progress (now)
panels.description: sum(gardenio_agent_compactions_current): agents compacting their context window right now — instantaneous back-pressure against the context ceiling. Green 0 is the healthy state the epic was chasing. Reads the gauge INSTANTLY: the old sum(last_over_time(...[$__range])) re-dated the last sample anywhere in the window as 'now', so a compaction that finished hours ago kept the stat lit. Honest-zero: 'or vector(0)' + green-at-0 shows a truthful earned 0, never a colored 'No data'. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `up{component="agents"} == 1`, so a 0 appears only while the controller exporter is actually being scraped.

defaults.noValue: exporter dark — the controller scrape is down, so this panel cannot tell a real 0 from a counter that is simply gone

panels.title: Boot Composition — what the start is made of (Part A budget story)
Boot Context Tokens per Session — avg + p95 by project
panels.description: gardenio_session_boot_context_tokens over time. Solid = avg, dashed = p95, per project. Dashed reference lines at 55k (drift watch, orange) and 85k (crisis line, red): the whole point is to SEE the live series sitting far below the ~70-90k crisis band the ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH flip (!5340) pulled us out of.

panels.title: Prime-Hook Composition by Source (bytes at agent start)
panels.description: gardenio_prime_hook_bytes by source — the gb-prime SessionStart-HOOK slice (advice/wrapup/workflow/roster/identity), stacked. This is the ~7k hook portion ONLY; it structurally cannot see the base system prompt, MCP tool defs, skills, or CLAUDE.md (those live in the Boot Context stat above, which is the full ~35-40k). Advice is the fat slice and must stay trended-down after the Part-A cut. NOTE: this is a set-once-at-boot gauge, so panels evaluate it over the range window (it looks empty on a bare instant query, but is fully live — 192 series/6h). ~bytes/4 = tokens.

panels.title: Advice Bytes per Archetype (project/role) vs Budget
panels.description: Worst-case advice section per (project, role) archetype against the 18k-token soft (72KB, yellow) / 20k-token hard (80KB, red) budget (ka-0000006677). The AdviceContextOverBudget vmalert fires on the hard line. Set-once gauge → evaluated over range. This is the live proof Part A holds: every archetype must sit under the yellow line.

panels.title: Live Context-Window Occupancy — top 10 hottest sessions
panels.description: gardenio_session_context_tokens for the 10 sessions closest to the ceiling right now (topk-10, named). The raw metric has ~219 agent_name series — this replaces that illegible spaghetti with the specific sessions an operator would actually go look at. stepAfter interpolation shows compaction sawtooth drops truthfully. Dashed red line at 200k marks approach-to-limit.

panels.title: Turns Completed per Hour by project
panels.description: sum by (project)(increase(gardenio_session_turns_total[1h])). FIXES the old board's most-broken panel: it used rate() over a 15m window on a per-session MONOTONIC gauge, which read 'No data' whenever no turn landed in 15m. increase() over 1h is the honest way to read a monotonic per-session gauge. Bars stack to the fleet total.

panels.title: Compactions per Hour (context-limit hits)
panels.description: sum(increase(gardenio_session_compactions_total[1h])): fleet compaction rate — the direct symptom the context crisis caused (agents overflowing the window and being forced to compact). Audit idea #15. 'or vector(0)' keeps a truthful flat-zero line instead of collapsing to 'No data' when there is genuinely no churn. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `count(gardenio_session_duration_seconds) > 0` — the one session metric `gb` pushes unconditionally on every session close — so a 0 here means sessions really are reporting, not that the push path went quiet. Currently ~0/h, the good-news state.

defaults.noValue: exporter dark — no session has pushed metrics for this project/account, so a real 0 cannot be told apart from a silent push path

panels.title: Session Duration p95 by role
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95, ... gardenio_agent_session_duration_seconds_bucket) by role — how long sessions run, by role. Connects context health to the outcome operators care about. This is the panel the $role variable filters (role lives on the duration histogram, not on the raw session gauges).

panels.title: Context-Window Occupancy — fleet quantile bands
panels.description: gardenio_session_context_tokens collapsed across ALL sessions into p50 / p95 / max, so the whole-fleet distribution stays legible at any session count (the second half of the anti-spaghetti fix, paired with the top-10 panel above). Dashed red at 200k marks the typical window ceiling.

panels.title: Cache-Read Share of Token Throughput
panels.description: cache_read / (input + cache_read). HIGH IS EXPECTED and economically favorable — the fixed boot is re-read every turn at cache price, which is WHY shrinking the boot mattered. ~99% today: virtually all token flow is cache-reads of the resident boot, so every kilobyte of boot is paid on every turn. Informational (blue), not an alarm. Reads increase() over the dashboard window rather than sum(last_over_time(...)): the latter re-dated each pod's last cumulative sample as "now", so a fleet that went quiet kept showing a live share. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `count(gardenio_session_output_tokens_total) > 0` — a sibling counter from the same agent-pod exporter — so a 0 means the exporter is up and reported no cache reads.

defaults.noValue: exporter dark — no agent pod is reporting session token counters for this project/account, so the share is unknown rather than 0

targets.expr: (sum(increase(gardenio_session_cache_read_tokens_total{project=~"$project", account=~"$account"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(gardenio_session_input_tokens_total{project=~"$project", account=~"$account"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(gardenio_session_cache_read_tokens_total{project=~"$project", account=~"$account"}[$__range])), 1)) or (vector(0) and (count(gardenio_session_output_tokens_total{project=~"$project", account=~"$account"}) > 0))

panels.title: Fleet Spend Rate (LiteLLM, USD/h · real bill)
panels.description: Authoritative real-bill LiteLLM spend rate from gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} — increase((max by (dim, value, env) (...))[1h:5m]) reads USD accrued in the trailing hour (USD/h); the max-by dedups per-pod churn and the [1h:5m] aligned subquery de-bumps the extrapolation sawtooth (same shape as the /costs fleet-rate headline, costs_rate.go). The real-money companion to cache-read share — cache-reads of the resident boot dominate token flow (~99%), and this is what that flow costs per hour. Honors the $project lens; the per-project tag gauge carries no account/role labels, so those template filters cannot scope it (small untagged residual ~5-10%, ka-0000003988). Replaces increase(gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total[1h]): that at-close counter is confirmed dead in prod (0 live series) and was retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592). Validated against the derived token-load proxy in the cross-check below. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `up{component="agents"} == 1`, so a 0 appears only while the controller exporter is actually being scraped.

defaults.noValue: exporter dark — the controller scrape is down, so this panel cannot tell a real 0 from a counter that is simply gone

targets.expr: sum(increase((max by (dim, value, env) (gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project", value=~"$project"}))[1h:5m])) or (vector(0) and (max(up{component="agents"}) == 1))

panels.title: Two-Measurement Cost Cross-Check — are our meters honest?
Token-Load Proxy vs Authoritative LiteLLM Cost
panels.description: Matt's two-measurement validation (ka-0000001494). Two INDEPENDENT measurement pipelines on a shared crosshair: the turns×context token-load proxy (left axis, blue, token-turns/h) and authoritative LiteLLM USD spend (right axis, green, USD/h). The USD spend is the real-bill per-project tag gauge gardenio_tag_cost_usd{dim="project"} windowed as increase((max by (dim, value, env) (...))[1h:5m]) — max-by dedups per-pod churn, the [1h:5m] subquery de-bumps the sawtooth. If they track → both meters are real. If they diverge → one is broken; investigate the MEASUREMENT, not the workload. Full-width because reading the two shapes against each other is the entire point. The honest capstone proving the token accounting the rest of this board relies on is trustworthy. Spend re-pointed off the dead at-close counter gardenio_agent_spend_usd_total (0 live series in prod), retired fleet-wide (ka-0000005951 / ka-0000007592).

panels.title: Live session latency — how the LLM/tool round-trip spreads (ka-0000001465)
LLM request-latency fan (p50 / p90 / p99)
panels.description: Per-response LLM API latency for live sessions, from gardenio_agent_llm_request_latency_seconds_bucket ({agent_name,project,account}). The translucent p50→p90→p99 bands show how wide the round-trip spread is right now — a flaring fan means the tail is pulling away from the median even while p50 holds. Scoped by the same $project / $account as the rest of this session board. Full distribution heatmaps for all five latency families live on the 'Agent Latency & Distribution' board (uid gardenio-agent-latency-distribution).

panels.title: Tool-call latency fan (p50 / p90 / p99)
panels.description: Per-call tool latency for live sessions, from gardenio_agent_tool_call_latency_seconds_bucket ({agent_name,project,account}), emitted by coop between ToolBefore→ToolAfter. Same p50/p90/p99 ribbon, same $project / $account scope as the LLM fan beside it.

panels.title: Advice Corpus Weight — pre-prompt dead-weight (bug ka-0000001234)
Advice Corpus Bytes (total, pre-prompt weight)
panels.description: sum(gardenio_advice_catalog_bytes) — total bytes of advice compiled into agent pre-prompts across every (project, role, scope) archetype. This is the corpus-bloat number the pre-prompt-dead-weight initiative (bug ka-0000001234) is trying to hold down: every kilobyte here is re-read on every turn of every session at cache-read price. Has climbed iteration over iteration (2.41 MiB on 2026-08-02 → ~4.94 MiB now). Filterable by $project/$role. You cannot manage corpus bloat you cannot see.

panels.title: Heaviest Advice Archetypes (topk 10 · project/role/scope)
panels.description: topk(10, sum by(project,role,scope)(gardenio_advice_catalog_bytes)) — the ten heaviest advice catalogs by archetype. Shows which (project, role, scope) combinations carry the most pre-prompt weight so grooming can target the worst offenders. Heaviest archetype ≈ 66 KiB live. Instant snapshot; filterable by $project/$role.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (project, role, scope) (gardenio_advice_catalog_bytes{project=~"$project", role=~"$role"}))

panels.title: Session Cache-Efficiency (cache-read share of token spend)
panels.description: cache_read / (input + cache_read + cache_write) over the live account-token gauges (gardenio_account_*_tokens_current). A $-weighted cache-efficiency KPI: what fraction of total token flow is cheap cache-reads of the resident boot rather than fresh input or cache-writes. HIGH IS GOOD (cache-read is the cheapest token). ~96% fleet-wide. Complements the context-obs 'Cache-Read Share of Token Throughput' stat (which omits cache-write from the denominator) with a spend-weighted view. Filterable by $account. Empty-branch liveness: the `or vector(0)` fallback is gated on `up{component="agents"} == 1`, so a 0 appears only while the controller exporter is actually being scraped.

defaults.noValue: exporter dark — the controller scrape is down, so this panel cannot tell a real 0 from a counter that is simply gone

panels.title: Session Cache-Efficiency — trend
panels.description: Same ratio as the gauge at left, over the dashboard window: cache_read / (input + cache_read + cache_write) from the live gardenio_account_*_tokens_current gauges. Watching this fall would mean a rising share of token spend on fresh input / cache-writes rather than cheap cache-reads of the resident boot. Filterable by $account.
